name: Remindarr
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" bash -s bun-v1.3.9 && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run build

terminals.name: remindarr
terminals.description: Remindarr server on http://localhost:3000 (serves the built frontend + API). Uses a placeholder TMDB_API_KEY unless the TMDB_API_KEY secret is set — live browse/search need a real key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; mkdir -p data; export TMDB_API_KEY="${TMDB_API_KEY:-placeholder-dev-key}"; export BETTER_AUTH_SECRET="${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}"; export BASE_URL="${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export DB_PATH="${DB_PATH:-data/remindarr.db}"; bun run start
